title: Correcting what Chef Mealan read: by words on the read, by hand on the Plate
short: A read is corrected by words on the read (tap a food, tell Chef Mealan) and by hand on the Plate
rel: Proposed; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
boardTitle: DT318: correcting what Chef Mealan read. By words on the read, by hand on the Plate

opportunity.from: Coach Milan, 18 November 2026, 19:26, from a photo he logged; and 21:48 with a screenshot of a tester's read.
opportunity.job: Make the list of foods right after a read, quickly, so the meal I log is the meal I ate.
opportunity.kind: Several doors, each doing part of the job: a tap on a chip, Change the foods, a swipe, a link to a form, and Chef Mealan's own question. None says which to use.
opportunity.why_now: Every read ends here. B150 changes the same screen, so both are tested once.

problem: After the read I got a nice list of foods. Chef Mealan asked about the chicken and I chose 200 g. The yogurt was fixed at 10% fat, which I saw only in the food list, not on the chip. I tried to swap it, but there was no 0.2% yogurt. So I told Chef Mealan: it was 0.2% yogurt, and there was mayo. He read again and asked about the chicken a second time, now 220 g. The list was right in the end, but where and how to correct it was confusing.
story: When a read is not quite right, I want one place to correct the foods, with my hands or with my words, so that I do not hunt for the right door and nothing I set is lost.
words: 18 November 19:26: jogurt was with 10% fixed in the food list, not on the read chip. I tried to swap for 0.2% fat but such jogurt was not listed. I added info as mayo was not recognized and said that I had 0.2% fat jogurt. Then it asked me again about the chicken, this time if it was 220 g. A bit confusing where and how to update it.
cause: Replayed on the app as built in 0.3.159. The chip shows a short name, so 10% fat is cut off. The question about an amount is not on the read; it is on the screen behind Change the foods. The swap list offers foods from my own list. And a second read starts from the photo again: it drops the amount I chose and asks anew.
words2: 19:43: better an edit mode where what is needed is set, than another way of correction. 21:48: saying it to Chef Mealan worked very well. So we have several places for making it better and each of them does some work. 23:33: editing chips is double work from the block where we edit foods anyway. A branch is drawn from its screen, or as a flow of its own. 23:44: select a chip and tell the chef what it is or is not; that is for using the chef for a second read. If correcting the read, send it to the Plate for editing. Keep the current few checks, where a pure guess is better than nothing.
proposed: Three things, each with one job. By words, on the read: a tap on a chip marks it, and one field under the chips takes what I tell Chef Mealan about it, typed or said; with no chip marked, the field takes a missing food. Read again makes him read with my words. By hand: the button Edit on the Plate opens the Plate's food list, where foods are edited anyway. His own checks, the few questions about a kind or an amount, stay as they are. The chips show the food's full name. What I set stays when he reads again, and he does not ask about it a second time.
more_change: Three things change that are built today. 1. A tap on a chip marks it for Chef Mealan; today it turns the chip into a number. Grams are typed on the Plate. 2. Change the foods is named Edit on the Plate. 3. The link Wrong foods? Help Chef Mealan read it goes from the Plate's screen; its job is the field on the read.
open: One thing for your word. The link Wrong foods? Help Chef Mealan read it sits on the Plate's screen today. I took it out, so words have one place. Say if it should stay.
days: The board is drawn on the app's test photo. The foods are yours: chicken, sweet potato fries, yogurt, mayonnaise.
unchanged: The photo, the title, the meal line, This plate and the end of the read.
The Plate's food list: grams, the swipe to swap or remove, + Add more to your plate, Fit to my target, Group into parts.
Chef Mealan's own questions about a kind or an amount, and where they stand.
Say it: the same voice input as on the photo form.
details: No new screen and no new editor.
Read again sends the photos, my words, the food they are about, and what I set before: amounts I typed or answered. The read keeps those.
One line from Chef Mealan says what the second read changed.
A food he changed or added is marked on its chip until the next tap.
The doubled foods of a tester are B152, not this ticket.
The row DT318.1 on this board, steps 1 to 4, is what it looks like.

ac.title: A chip shows the full name
ac.text: Given Chef Mealan read a photo, when I look under the photo, then each chip shows the food's full name and grams, such as Yogurt, 10% fat ~80 g.

ac.title: A tap on a chip marks it
ac.text: Given that read, when I tap the yogurt's chip, then the chip is marked with a tick, the field under the chips says About: Yogurt, 10% fat, and the chip does not turn into a number.

ac.title: By words, about a food
ac.text: Given the yogurt is marked, when I write It was 0.2% fat and tap Read again, then the chip says Yogurt, 0.2% fat, and one line from Chef Mealan says what he changed.

ac.title: By words, a missing food
ac.text: Given no chip is marked, when I write There was mayo too and tap Read again, then a chip Mayonnaise is there, marked as new.

ac.title: Said, not typed
ac.text: Given the field, when I tap Say it and speak, then my words stand in the field as if typed.

ac.title: What I set stays
ac.text: Given I set the chicken to 200 g on the Plate or answered Chef Mealan's question about it, when he reads again, then the chicken is still 200 g and he does not ask about it again.

ac.title: By hand, on the Plate
ac.text: Given the read, when I tap Edit on the Plate, then the Plate opens with its food list as it is today, and there is no button Change the foods.

ac.title: His checks stay
ac.text: Given a read that is not sure about a kind or an amount, when I open the Plate, then his question is there as it is today.

ac.title: One place for words
ac.text: Given the Plate with a photo, when I look at it, then there is no link Wrong foods? Help Chef Mealan read it.

ac.title: Three languages
ac.text: Given the app in English, Serbian or German, when I walk steps 1 to 4, then Tell Chef Mealan what is wrong, About, Read again, Edit on the Plate and Chef Mealan's line are in that language.
